ChatSession.title: ChatSession
ChatSession.description: A visitor Q&A conversation session recorded privately for administrator review.

title.description: Summary title derived from the first question in the session.

messageCount.description: Total number of messages recorded in this session.

lastMessagePreview.description: Short preview snippet of the latest message.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the session was last updated.

SessionMessage.title: SessionMessage
SessionMessage.description: An individual user question or assistant answer recorded within a session for admin inspection.

content.description: Markdown or plain text content of the message.

clientTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds timestamp for chronological ordering.

userQuery.description: Associated user prompt for assistant responses.

feedback.description: User feedback rating for this assistant message.

error.description: Optional error message if generation failed.

sources.description: Bounded list of cited knowledge base sources (max 15).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when message was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when message was last updated.

/chat_sessions/{sessionId}.description: Private chat sessions readable and deletable exclusively by verified administrator.

/chat_sessions/{sessionId}/messages/{mes.description: Messages belonging to a chat session, readable and deletable exclusively by verified administrator.
